description: مرحبًا! أنا المعتصم بالله من العراق. أهتم بالفضاء والعلوم والتكنولوجيا واستكشاف المريخ. أعمل على فكرة Mars Explorer لتحديد المواقع الآمنة لهبوط الروبوتات على المريخ. أبحث عن أعضاء مبدعين ومتعاونين ومهتمين بالبحث العلمي أو التصميم أو البرمجة. لا يشترط وجود خبرة سابقة، فالأهم هو حب التعلم والعمل الجماعي. 🚀
summary: ASTRA NOVA: LUNAR OUTPOST is an interactive educational Android game developed by Andromeda Iraqi Team | Astra Nova, an independent team from Iraq. The game introduces players to the Moon and space exploration through educational activities and interactive challenges. Its goal is to make learning about space more accessible and enjoyable, while encouraging scientific curiosity and inspiring young people to explore the universe.
details: ASTRA NOVA: LUNAR OUTPOST is an interactive educational Android game developed by Andromeda Iraqi Team | Astra Nova, an independent team from Iraq. The game focuses on the Moon and space exploration, providing an educational experience through interactive activities and learning challenges. Its main goal is to make space education more accessible, interesting, and enjoyable for students and young learners. The project combines education and interactive gameplay to encourage curiosity, scientific thinking, and interest in space and technology. ASTRA NOVA represents our ambition to inspire young people in Iraq and around the world to explore the universe and discover the wonders of science. The game was developed as an Android APK and focuses on educational space exploration rather than managing a lunar settlement or its resources.
